svg.text: VLM-DENTAL: synthetic trace synthesis and two-stage training pipeline
frontier teacher via rate-limited provider pool
reasoning turns interleaved with real tool output
tiered perturbation of the box shown to the teacher
the real crops the tools produced;
multi-finding F1 accuracy - format - tool validity
locate_tooth and nudge_crop exempt from call cost
One agent loop, one tool dispatcher, one image-input geometry (native, or canonical views when training on TPU)
across trace generation, RL rollouts, and evaluation; tool calls execute for real against the source image at every stage.
During trace generation only: locate_tooth returns the expert-verified box for annotated teeth, and the perturbation hook independently perturbs the box shown.
